title: Purdue AF Resource Utilization
description: CPU, memory and GPUs in the cms namespace: reserved by requests and actually used, as rolling averages.

panels.title: CPU: reserved vs. used
panels.description: Cores in the cms namespace. Reserved: pod CPU requests counted against the namespace quota. Used: CPU time the containers consumed. Each point is one minute.

panels.title: Memory: reserved vs. used
panels.description: Memory in the cms namespace. Reserved: pod memory requests counted against the namespace quota. Used: working set of the containers. Each point is one minute.

panels.title: GPU: reserved vs. used
panels.description: GPU devices (whole GPUs and MIG slices, one each) in the cms namespace. Reserved: devices requested by pods. Used: sum of the graphics-engine activity of those devices, so one device busy all the time counts as 1. Each point is one minute.
